Caption (Arabic): في هذا العدد: ان هوليود تمر بمحنة جديدة انها محنة الافلام الفاسدة.
Caption (English): In this issue: Hollywood is going through a new ordeal — the ordeal of corrupt films.
Notes: Image shows Western-style glamour while caption critiques Hollywood corruption

Caption (Arabic): شجرة الزيتون :بقلم محمد كامل حسن المحامي
Caption (English): The Olive Tree — by Mohamed Kamel Hassan, Attorney

Caption (Arabic): حدث هذا الاسبوع: فصلي فستانك على احدث الموديلات ومعه حزام جلد وزجاجة رائحة هدية ٨٠ عند فستان جميل. الزوج مش قلتلك السينيما بتجيب افلام كويسة
Caption (English): This happened this week: Have your dress tailored in the latest styles — with a leather belt and a bottle of perfume as a gift — 80 piasters at Beautiful Dress [boutique]. // The husband: Didn't I tell you the cinema brings good films?
Notes: Two captions on one page: a fashion ad and a cartoon joke

Caption (Arabic): سلكات افصل صابون للحمام والتواليت. تصوري لكل سيجارة لون/كوكتيل سجاير / السيجارة المفضلة لكل حسناء
Caption (English): Selkat — the finest soap for the bathroom and toilet. Imagine — every cigarette has a color / Cocktail Cigarettes / The favorite cigarette of every beautiful woman.
Notes: Two ads on one page: soap and cigarettes, both sold through women

Caption (Arabic): للانيقات لكل سيجارة لون بلائم لون فستانك
Caption (English): For the elegant — every cigarette has a color that matches the color of your dress.
Notes: Continuation of Cocktail Cigarettes campaign

Caption (Arabic): اختي العربية الناهضة في كل مكان في الشرق / مع حواء / زفاف مرجريت وحريتها
Caption (English): My Arab Sister Rising Everywhere in the East / With Eve [women's column] / The Wedding of Margaret and Her Freedom
Notes: Individual woman elevated to symbol of Arab renaissance; wedding paired with freedom

Caption (Arabic): شباب ورياضة/ كل سيدة انيقة تحرص ان تكون فساتينها ملائمة لكل انواع نشاطتها اليومية لذلك يجب ان تكون دولابك مجموعة ملائمة لجميع النشاطات
Caption (English): Youth and Sports / Every elegant lady makes sure her dresses are suited to all types of her daily activities — therefore your wardrobe must be a collection suited to all occasions.
Notes: Sports section header used to redirect into fashion/wardrobe advice

Caption (Arabic): هذه المجموعة من الفساتين البسيطة اخترناها لك من طراز جميل ويمكن تصميمها من الاقمشة العملية
Caption (English): We have selected for you this collection of simple dresses of a beautiful style — and they can be made from practical fabrics.

Caption (Arabic): انتهى الصيف الجميل
Caption (English): The beautiful summer has ended.
Notes: Woman used as symbol of seasonal melancholy

Caption (Arabic): خدعني زوجي/ غدا الاحد بسينيما ريتس (عريس مراتي) / زيني بيتك بالقواقع
Caption (English): My husband deceived me / Tomorrow Sunday at Ritz Cinema: My Wife's Groom / Decorate your home with seashells.
Notes: Three unrelated captions: marital story, film ad, home craft tip

Caption (Arabic): احذروا هذه النجمة اسمها هايا وبلدها اسرائيل وهدفها هوليود
Caption (English): Beware of this star — her name is Haya, her country is Israel, and her goal is Hollywood.
Notes: Glamorous actress image weaponized as political warning; visual admiration undercut by nationalist caption

Caption (Arabic): شبابنا يخشا الجامعات / كانت زوجتي تنتهز وجود اقاربي من الريفين لتحدث والدتها واخوتها بالفرنسية
Caption (English): Our youth fear universities / My wife used to seize the opportunity of having my rural relatives present to speak to her mother and brothers in French.
Notes: KEY IMAGE: French used as social performance in front of rural relatives — modernity as class display

Caption (Arabic): جذوة تحت الرماد بقلم صوفي عبدالله
Caption (English): An Ember Under the Ashes — by Sophie Abdullah.
Notes: Woman writer; title metaphor of hidden fire — image carries suppressed resilience

Caption (Arabic): هوليود تستسلم لاسراىيل، من سلاح اسراىيل البحري الى هوليود قصة استر الذي خطبها بن هور، ريتا واخواتها في البلاتوه
Caption (English): Hollywood surrenders to Israel / From the Israeli navy to Hollywood / The story of Esther who was engaged to Ben-Hur / Rita and her sisters on the set.
Notes: Pair with kawakib_0012: Israeli actresses framed as political threat; glamour weaponized as warning

Caption (Arabic): هايا او استر مع خطيبها بن هود (شارلتون هوستون في الفلم الذي يحمل اسمه / زيفارودن خلصت ملابس الجنود لتلبس المايوه وهجرت اسراىيل لتور هوليود
Caption (English): Haya or Esther with her fiancé Ben-Hur (Charlton Heston in the film that bears his name) / [Ziva] traded soldier's clothes for a swimsuit and left Israel to conquer Hollywood.
Notes: Third in series (0012, 0017, 0018): military uniform to swimsuit — female body as both national tool and Hollywood threat

Caption (Arabic): هند تقول لاحسان: كرهتها من اجل زوجها، انكرها ابوها، احببت..ومرتين وفشلت / لفاء بين نجوم الشاشة ونجوم القلم
Caption (English): Hind tells Ihsan: I hated her for her husband's sake, her father denied her, I loved... twice and failed. / A meeting between stars of the screen and stars of the pen.
Notes: Serialized emotional drama alongside cultural elite gathering — two registers on one page

Caption (Arabic): بشرتك الناعمة لا يصلح لها الا صابون سلكت / وحياتك يا اخويا تخليني اتعلم الموسيقى
Caption (English): For your soft skin, nothing suits it but Selkat soap. / I swear to you, brother, let me learn music.
Notes: Selkat soap ad (3rd appearance); woman's skin as product surface

Caption (Arabic): اكاذيب وحقاىف
Caption (English): Lies and Truths.
Notes: Woman's image made to carry a piece on deception vs. reality — visual and concept in productive tension

Caption (Arabic): ابتعد عن انيتا اكبرغ والا انتظر الموت
Caption (English): Stay away from Anita Ekberg or await death.
Notes: Anita Ekberg (La Dolce Vita); Western glamour reframed as romantic danger

Caption (Arabic): انا بحبك يا مصطفى
Caption (English): I love you, Mustafa.
Notes: Possibly ref. to Bob Azzam 1960 hit song; woman as voice of romantic feeling

Caption (Arabic): قلب سعاد حسني، قلب الموجي وقلب العطار
Caption (English): The heart of Soad Hosny, the heart of Al-Mawji, and the heart of Al-Attar.
Notes: Soad Hosny (Cinderella of Egyptian cinema) — she is the axis, men's hearts orbit her

Caption (Arabic): الرقص فن والتمثيل موهبة والزواج مصيبة والحب... يا ساتر
Caption (English): Dancing is an art, acting is a talent, marriage is a calamity, and love… God protect us.
Notes: KEY IMAGE: comic hierarchy — professional excellence at top, marriage disaster, love unspeakable; dry social critique

Caption (Arabic): هنري تورو: كاتب انساني عالمي ازواج الستار عن كثير من معايبنا الاخلاقية والفكرية في كتابه الرائع اكعصان. الثمن ٧٥ ف.ل
Caption (English): Henry Thoreau: a universal humanist writer who lifted the veil on many of our moral and intellectual flaws in his wonderful book [Walden]. Price: 75 fils.
Notes: Woman used as visual hook for Thoreau book ad — her image sells moral philosophy

Caption (Arabic): لم اتزوج لنداء الحب ولكن طلبا للراجة
Caption (English): I did not marry for the call of love, but in pursuit of rest.
Notes: KEY IMAGE: frank rejection of romantic marriage ideology — pragmatic honesty as quiet resistance

Caption (Arabic): تفاصيل مثيرة عن زواج ليلى فوزي و جلال معوض، والد العروس يسقط مريضا ومطلقة العريس تقيم ركوى نفقة
Caption (English): Exciting details about the marriage of Layla Fawzy and Jalal Muawwad — the bride's father falls ill, and the groom's ex-wife files for alimony.
Notes: Actress Layla Fawzy; professional image redirected into tabloid wedding drama

Caption (Arabic): لبنى عبد العزيز: النجمة التي خلقت من المنتج مخرجا
Caption (English): Lobna Abdel Aziz: The star who turned the producer into a director.
Notes: Actress as creative force — she remakes a man's identity; power hidden behind the star image

Caption (Arabic): قلب زبيرة ثروت يخفق بحب عبد الحليم: صلاح ذو الفقار يطلق زهرة العلا / نجات الصغيرة تتزوج احمد منسي بعد الطلاق / هل تعود مريم فخر الدين الى محمود ذو الفقار
Caption (English): Zubayra Tharwat's heart beats with love for Abdel Halim / Salah Dhul-Fiqar divorces Zahra Al-Ala / Najat Al-Saghira marries Ahmed Mansi after divorce / Will Maryam Fakhr al-Din return to Mahmoud Dhul-Fiqar?
Notes: Four professional women (actress/singer) reduced entirely to romantic/marital status; careers invisible

Caption (Arabic): الوسط السينيماى في القاهرة لم يشهد فترة كتلك التي مر بها فترة مشحونة بالحب
Caption (English): The cinema world in Cairo has never witnessed a period as charged with love as the one it is going through.
Notes: Individual woman elevated to embody an entire era of cinematic romance in Cairo

Caption (Arabic): نصف زوجة
Caption (English): Half a wife.
Notes: KEY IMAGE: visual wholeness undone by caption — woman made a fraction; likely polygamy or secondary marriage

Caption (Arabic): بلاد الهاراكيري تنافس هوليود / الفلم الياباني يمد لسانه لهوليود
Caption (English): The land of hara-kiri competes with Hollywood / Japanese film sticks its tongue out at Hollywood.
Notes: Japanese woman's image made to embody national cinema defiance against Hollywood

Caption (Arabic): عدسة العروس في المهرجان الاسيوي الافريقي للسينيما
Caption (English): The bride's lens at the Asian-African Cinema Festival.
Notes: Bandung-era Asian-African solidarity; woman's image at international political-cultural festival

Caption (Arabic): افلام حلمي رقلة تقدم لحن السعادة
Caption (English): Helmy Raqla Films presents: The Melody of Happiness.
Notes: Film promotional still; woman as advertisement for cinema

Caption (Arabic): ملوك الفرفشة لا يعرفون الضحك
Caption (English): The kings of fun don't know how to laugh.
Notes: Paradox: entertainers who produce joy are themselves joyless; smile in image undercut by caption

Caption (Arabic): حكايات فنية ام كلثوم والخوف
Caption (English): Artistic tales: Umm Kulthum and fear.
Notes: KEY IMAGE: Umm Kulthum — icon of Arab power — paired with fear; monumental image made vulnerable

Caption (Arabic): لوكريس بورجيا اغرب رواية عرفتها تاريخ البشرية
Caption (English): Lucrezia Borgia — the strangest story humanity has ever known.
Notes: Western historical figure (Borgia) borrowed for Arab readers; woman as embodiment of historical scandal

Caption (Arabic): نصف عمري في السرير، جاكلين بلا قميص نوم
Caption (English): Half my life in bed / Jacqueline without a nightgown.
Notes: Tabloid double: vulnerability (bed/illness) + voyeurism (celebrity undress); body as spectacle

Caption (Arabic): انها لا تنام قبل الساعة الثانية
Caption (English): She does not sleep before two o'clock.
Notes: Intimate detail elevated to define character — a woman of the night

Caption (Arabic): اخر صورة للثناىي الذي لاقى نجاح باهر في القاهرة
Caption (English): The last photo of the duo that achieved great success in Cairo.
Notes: Professional portrait becomes elegiac; success and ending in same caption

Caption (Arabic): الفيلم الاول ببطولة جين مانسفيلد مع زوجها مايك هارغيتي
Caption (English): The first film starring Jayne Mansfield with her husband Mickey Hargitay.
Notes: Jayne Mansfield — Hollywood bombshell exported to Arab readers; Western glamour borrowed

Caption (Arabic): افلام حلمي رقلة تقدم لاول مرة مريم فخر الدين و فريد شوقي
Caption (English): Helmy Raqla Films presents for the first time: Maryam Fakhr al-Din and Farid Shawqi.
Notes: Film promotional ad; Maryam Fakhr al-Din paired with Farid Shawqi (King of Third World cinema)

Caption (Arabic): التلقزيون / ادخل برنامج جديد اسمه بيني وبينك
Caption (English): Television / A new program has been introduced called Between You and Me.
Notes: Woman as face of new television medium; intimate address format — modernity through direct connection

Caption (Arabic): سوال للجمهور هل تخلع نجوى فواد بدلة الرقص لتحتفظ ب فواد حسن
Caption (English): A question for the public: Will Nagwa Fouad take off her dance costume to keep Fouad Hassan?
Notes: KEY IMAGE: Nagwa Fouad asked to choose career vs man — dance costume as professional identity made contingent on love

Caption (Arabic): الفلم اللبناني العالمي حكم القدر
Caption (English): The Lebanese international film: The Judgment of Fate.
Notes: Lebanese film promotion; positioned as world-class cinema

Caption (Arabic): ذهبت راىحة البترول عن فساتين كريمة، طار من يدها خاتم سولتير ب ١٠ والف جنيه، مليونير سعودي اراد طردها من بيتها، زوجها اختار الطلاق بدل السجن
Caption (English): The smell of oil has left Karima's dresses / A solitaire ring worth 10,000 pounds flew from her hand / A Saudi millionaire wanted to evict her from her home / Her husband chose divorce over prison.
Notes: KEY IMAGE: woman surrounded by men's financial crimes and choices — oil wealth, eviction, divorce; she bears consequences of others

Caption (Arabic): ممنوع زواج مذيعات التلفزيون
Caption (English): Marriage is forbidden for female television presenters.
Notes: KEY IMAGE: professional access given, private life denied — modernity conditional on remaining unmarried

Caption (Arabic): الاستاذ ايميل دبغي، اتيحت له فرصة مشاهدة كواليس الفيلم الكمدي ارض الصحاري
Caption (English): Professor Emil Dabghi was given the opportunity to watch the behind-the-scenes of the comedy film Land of Deserts.
Notes: Woman on film set; caption centers male observer given access to watch her — she is spectacle, he is gaze

Caption (Arabic): ما كادت المطربة الجزائرية وردة تنزل في مطار القاهرة حتى استقلت سيارتها الكاديلاك / النجمة الحسناء زبيدة ثروت قامت بزيارة مكتب الموعد في القاهرة ظلت تقلب اعداد المجلة القديمة حتى عثرت على العدد الذي نشر فيه اول ريبورتاج مصور عنها / تشهد القاهرة اليوم بوادر غرام عنيف يتبادله الموسيقار محمد فوزي والنجمة الناشئة الهام زكي
Caption (English): No sooner had Algerian singer Warda landed at Cairo airport than she got into her Cadillac / Zubayda Tharwat visited Al-Mawed office in Cairo — she searched old issues until she found her own first photo reportage / Cairo witnesses early signs of violent romance between Mohamed Fawzi and rising star Elham Zaki.
Notes: KEY IMAGE: meta-archival — a star searches this magazine for her own first image; Warda arriving; romance gossip; three registers at once

Caption (Arabic): حكايات النجوم
Caption (English): Stories of the Stars.
Notes: Section header — woman made face of all celebrity gossip, not just her own story

Caption (Arabic): في اوقات الفراغ
Caption (English): In leisure time.
Notes: Woman at rest — her leisure documented as worth seeing

Caption (Arabic): جديدة وانعم من اي وقت مضى مناشف كوتكس الصحية الجديدة ذات الفعول المضمون مريحة ولها مايزات عديدة
Caption (English): New and softer than ever — the new Kotex sanitary towels. With guaranteed effectiveness. Comfortable and with many advantages.
Notes: Kotex sanitary ad — most intimate product, most direct address to women through a woman's image

Caption (Arabic): اجمل اغاني الموسم لاشهر مطربي ومطربات العالم العربي على اسطوانات صوت الشرق PARLOPHONE
Caption (English): The most beautiful songs of the season / By the most famous singers of the Arab world / On records / Voice of the East — PARLOPHONE.
Notes: Parlophone Voice of the East label — Arab musical excellence on British record; woman as face of Arab song

Caption (Arabic): اجمل فيلم لاجمل قصة عرفتها السينما المصرية من اجل حبي
Caption (English): The most beautiful film for the most beautiful story Egyptian cinema has ever known: For My Love.
Notes: Film promotional ad with superlatives; woman as face of the greatest love story

Caption (Arabic): عادت فساتين الدكلتي لجسد صباح
Caption (English): The decollete dresses have returned to Sabah's body.
Notes: KEY IMAGE: Sabah's neckline treated as cultural news — the covering and uncovering of a woman's body as public event

Caption (Arabic): التلميذة
Caption (English): The Student.
Notes: Single word identity — woman as student; education as defining modern selfhood

Caption (Arabic): تفرج يا سلام على شاشة التلفزيون
Caption (English): Watch, oh my goodness, on the television screen!
Notes: Television as miracle; woman as its wondrous content — exclamation elevates her to spectacle

Caption (Arabic): بفكر في اللي ناسيني / هند رستم / شكري سرحان
Caption (English): I am thinking of the one who forgot me / Hind Rostom / Shoukry Sarhan.
Notes: Hind Rostom (Egypt's Marilyn Monroe) — bold actress given melancholy by film title; longing beneath the glamour

Caption (Arabic): ام كلثوم في عصر الصواريخ
Caption (English): Umm Kulthum in the age of rockets.
Notes: KEY IMAGE: ancient Arab voice placed in space age — tradition and technology in one woman

Caption (Arabic): مارلين مونرو في غرفة نوم عشيق جين مانسفيلد
Caption (English): Marilyn Monroe in the bedroom of Jayne Mansfield's lover.
Notes: Two Hollywood icons (Monroe + Mansfield) both reduced to a bedroom love triangle; glamour punctured by scandal
